name: Sync PlusVibe Campaigns to Hub
called_by: the Campaigns Manager, first thing every run
description: Reads every PlusVibe workspace on the Clients registry and writes each campaign as a Hub Campaigns row: Leads, Contacted, Positive Replies, Status. Refreshes the conversation thread of every replied prospect. Fires the client's pvsync add-on. Hands one summary back to the manager; no row of its own.
